template.name: MikroTik BaseBox Sector SNMP
template.description:
MikroTik BaseBox sector template for RouterOS wireless access points.
Built from live SNMP walk data from host 10.2.35.2. Monitors CPU, uptime, LAN status, SSID, client counts, frequency, band, noise floor, voltage, temperature, ICMP, and connected client RX signal.
SNMP v2c. Zabbix 7.0/7.4 compatible.

template.name: MikroTik Sector Client Signals
template.description:
Signal-only MikroTik sector template.
Built from the MikroTik RB921 sector client identity discovery logic. Discovers wireless clients by MikroTik registration-table identity so RX signal items are named with the client/device name.
Keeps only the internal identity walk and the per-client RX signal discovery.

trigger_prototype.name: RX signal: {#CLIENT} is weak (<{$CLIENT.RSSI.WARN} dBm)
trigger_prototype.description: Client signal is weaker than configured threshold.

template.name: MikroTik Sector with Client Count
template.description: Sector/AP template for MikroTik RB921-type AP at 10.2.34.2. Built from the working Template_MikroTik_RB921_Sector_SNMP_10_2_41_130 with only the unsupported host-specific items removed for this device. Keeps ICMP, system health, LAN status, memory, CPU, wireless client count, and per-client RX signal discovery. Removes Wireless: Band and WLAN: Interface comment because 10.2.34.2 returns blank ifAlias values for interfaces and does not expose the same band OID/index structure used on 10.2.41.130.
